name: UEM Mini Game
author: Thiago Calvi
description: Dodge obstacles rushing at you down a road with a 3D depth effect: move and jump to survive as your score rises. Arrows to move, Up to jump, Z to pause.

descriptions.en: Dodge obstacles rushing at you down a road with a 3D depth effect: move and jump to survive as your score rises. Arrows to move, Up to jump, Z to pause.
descriptions.it: Schiva gli ostacoli che arrivano lungo una strada con effetto di profondità 3D: spostati e salta mentre il punteggio sale. Frecce per muoverti, su per saltare, Z pausa.
